# G PC Health — spec четырёх этапов, 08.10.2026

## Authority и текущая граница
Owner «Делай все релизы» утверждает дизайн и последовательность. Сейчас observer-only: только внешние документы, root review перед product effects; повторное согласование дизайна не требуется. Порядок 0.17.1 → 0.17.2 → 0.18.0 → 0.19.0, последовательно в этой существующей задаче, без subagents/new tasks/schedulers.
Inspected source: 9dac2653ca1e2d9c66a18505b15cb465f485ed04. Последний прочитанный coordination: 1e8149793d8fe0c21b39386e64e960424d5dedd4, чужой owned gen25 bb41abbc-4b1f-470b-8aaf-1ecdf2e53747; его lease/claims/handle не изменять. В момент каждого будущего эффекта нужны fresh source, runtime, ownership, guard и budget. Immutable CDC не менять.

## 0.17.1 — читаемый UI
В MainStrings.resx и MainStrings.en.resx заменить literal backslash+n настоящими переносами только в семи ключах каждого языка: Main.Message.Blocked; Main.Message.Confirm; Main.Message.Completed; Main.ExecutionContext.ProcessSession; Main.ExecutionContext.ScopeTooltip; Main.ExecutionContext.ActionScope; Main.ServiceDesk.RecommendedUnavailable. Итого 14 entries. Сохранить placeholders; не делать global/runtime unescape.
Findings — основная область; actions компактны, кнопки называют конкретное действие. Details selectable, scrollable, copyable. Семь metrics адаптируются к ширине, security coverage всегда доступна, RAM warning понятен. Splitter пропорциональный с минимумами обеих панелей. Проверить auxiliary dialogs: resize, DPI, RU/EN, RDP, keyboard/focus. Не менять action IDs, confirmation/UAC, execution order.

## 0.17.2 — отчёт и сортировки
Порядок: summary → findings → actions → security → processes/events → system/context. Общая semantic status/risk display order для UI/report; localized human control names при неизменных stable IDs. Unknown — verify-first, не healthy/failure и не разрешение исправлять. Anchors, responsive и print layout. Сохранить numeric sorting, selection identity, исходные facts, encoding/redaction. Display order никогда не меняет DISM→SFC execution.

## 0.18.0 — достоверный сбор ИБ
Typed Unknown reasons: RightsRequired, SourceUnavailable, Timeout, QueryError, PolicyMissing, UnsupportedField, SourceConflict. Cancellation отдельно от причины Unknown; partial facts сохраняются. Evidence хранит source, observation time, trustworthy source time если доступно, exit/return code и отдельно redacted stdout/stderr. Raw sensitive output не попадает в UI/report/exports.
Собранные facts отдельно от verdict. Существующая формула сохраняется: score = earned weight / known applicable weight; coverage = known applicable weight / all applicable weight; all-unknown score=null; N/A исключается. Нельзя улучшать оценку выдуманными facts.
KES: находить реально установленный CLI через documented install locations и registry (32/64-bit views); не arbitrary PATH. Перед запуском canonical absolute path, trusted file/publisher и допустимый fixed read-only argv. Раздельные exit/stdout/stderr, strict documented 0/1 payload parser; случайный token в diagnostic output не считается состоянием. Timeout/cancel, bounded output. Freshness только по достоверному definitions timestamp; file version — отдельный version fact, не свежесть.
BitLocker: убрать EncryptionPercentage из WMI SELECT, получать progress через GetConversionStatus; сохранять return code и права. ProtectionStatus отдельно от progress. Ошибка progress не удаляет успешно собранную protection evidence.
Local admins: полученный список без baseline → PolicyMissing, не collectorFailure. TPM Ready unknown и Windows firmware limitations показывать честно. Firewall Windows/KES/provider conflict различать; не приписывать состояние стороннего firewall Windows.
Общий deadline и cancellation: планируемый default 30s, KES query не более существующих 10s и остатка общего бюджета; bounded cleanup без бесконечного ожидания streams. Никакого automatic UAC, remediation или изменения защиты.
Fixtures: normal, admin-denied, conflict, timeout, partial, localized output; дополнительно cancellation, untrusted executable, malformed timestamps, missing baseline и sensitive redaction.

## 0.19.0 — углублённая read-only диагностика
Переиспользовать ProcessObservation, PerformanceSession, IncidentReview, StorageReview, EndpointReview, StartupReview; не создавать альтернативные collectors. Из summary/finding переходить к соответствующей read-only диагностике с исходным context.
Повторяющиеся события группировать по provider/id/message signature/time window. Frequency отдельно от impact/confidence; высокий count сам по себе не CRIT. Schannel не объявлять безвредным без контекстной evidence. Подпись детерминирована, original evidence сохраняется, redaction не раскрывает секреты.
Короткая CPU/RAM/IO session: использовать существующий default 120s/2s, hard existing bound 600s; cancellation. Показывать top contributors, фактические start/end, sample interval, valid/missed samples, coverage; отсутствующая метрика Unknown, не ноль. Не смешивать process identity после PID reuse.
Сравнение двух снимков: new/resolved/changed, schema version и source/completeness metadata. Stable item identities и совместимые schema; unavailable/incomplete observation не превращает исчезнувшую запись в resolved. Unsupported schema → явная невозможность сравнить, не пустой delta.
Детерминированные clock/source fixtures, UI/report parity и сохранение read-only boundaries.

## Уже реализовано и новые изменения — inspected source
SecurityPostureEvaluator.cs уже считает known-subset score/coverage и AssessmentIncomplete при coverage<80. SecurityPostureModels.cs уже разделяет snapshot/assessment, но SecurityEvidence содержит только Key/Value/Source — новые typed reasons/time/exit metadata нужны.
KasperskySecurityReader.cs уже использует два ProgramFiles locations, fixed OPSWAT queries и 10s timeout, не PATH. Не реализованы registry discovery/trust gate/structured execution result; stdout+stderr сейчас объединяются, exit не возвращается, RTP parser принимает любой найденный 0/1.
BitLockerSecurityCollector.cs уже отделяет protection/conversion status, но SELECT содержит EncryptionPercentage и progress читается как property — исправить query/method и partial evidence.
LocalAdministratorsCollector/Policy уже отдельны; требуется закрепить PolicyMissing при успешно полученном списке. WindowsPlatformSecurityCollector/FirmwareSecurityCollector имеют nullable observations/provider constraints — расширить причины и отображение, не переписать verdict с нуля.
Существуют перечисленные шесть диагностических модулей и их selftests. PerformanceSessionCore уже имеет duration/interval bounds, cancellation и completeness. Новое: summary navigation, event grouping semantics, contributor presentation и versioned cross-snapshot delta. Наличие модулей не доказывает выполнение всей новой acceptance matrix.

## Delivery, budgets и project gates
Четыре новые необходимые Windows test artifact cycles планируются, не запускаются. Существующий ledger/task/events/outcomes не обнулять. Explicit reviewed budget migration сохраняет charges/circuits; exact candidate/attempt bindings и durable reservation/readback перед эффектами. Нельзя потратить второй цикл через PR+pilot duplicate trigger. Provider quotas unknown без actual observation.
Каждый этап: targeted RED/GREEN, bounded diff/validators, один exact-SHA Windows artifact cycle, selftest/portable/version/checksum/pilot ZIP/upload/delivery, transactional executor release. Hosted Windows не означает real Windows11 GUI/UAC/RDP acceptance. Merge/main/production release только после real Windows11 pilot и explicit owner integration approval. Watchdog остаётся paused.

## Root-approved corrections after review
Budget proposal: preserve two existing charged CI cycles; four new artifact Windows cycles plus at most one required final-PR exact-head cycle, total task cap 7. Actions conserve; max one cycle per logical stage/final acceptance, no intermediate PR+pilot duplicate. Apply migration only after this executor has fresh managed ownership, not during foreign gen25. No restoration of exhausted policy and no ledger reset.
0.18: CT/Task timeout alone does not bound blocked WMI/native calls. Use a genuinely bounded native source or existing read-only child isolation with actual termination/quiescence; no indefinitely running background queries. KES timestamp rejects version tokens, ambiguous and future dates. Preserve original scoring formula and WARN on partial observations, including TPM present+Ready unknown.
0.19: 120s/2s means actual sampling, not immediate certainty. Bound top contributor count; identity PID+starttime; missing samples stay Unknown, never fabricated zero.
0.17.1: meaningful visibility/layout regression plus synthetic rendered Windows evidence. Use existing checks for XML newline correction; do not add tests that merely mirror the change. Immutable package unchanged: no full CDC suite on every product step.

# 0.18.0 Implementation Plan

> Метод: sequential native execution в existing task; executing-plans при implementation. Сейчас observer-only; root review перед effects. Дизайн уже утверждён, повторный approval request не нужен.

Spec: spec.md. Stack: C#/.NET8 WinForms, RESX, HTML, PowerShell7; fresh authoritative CDC в момент controls. Общие ограничения и delivery/budget gates из spec обязательны для всех задач. Future commits только в isolated managed writer после fresh ownership; чужой gen25 не трогать.

Goal: trustworthy typed evidence collection, без auto UAC или protection mutations.
Files: SecurityPostureModels.cs, SecurityPostureCollector.cs, KasperskySecurityReader.cs, BitLockerSecurityCollector.cs, LocalAdministratorsCollector.cs/LocalAdministratorsPolicy.cs, WindowsPlatformSecurityCollector.cs, FirmwareSecurityCollector.cs, SecurityReportSection.cs, MainForm.SecurityCollection.cs/MainForm.SecurityPosture.cs; соответствующие existing SelfTest.cs.
Review focus: partial success after failure, registry trust/path, localized/malformed CLI output, total timeout/cancel, missing policy versus collection failure.
1. [ ] Ввести SecurityUnknownReason с семью spec reasons; structured evidence source/ObservedAt/SourceTime/ExitCode и redacted stdout/stderr. Facts остаются отдельно от verdict; nullable unknown metadata backward-safe. Fixtures normal/denied/conflict/partial и UI/report parity; scoring formula unchanged/all-unknown null.
2. [ ] KES discovery: known install roots + registry 32/64 views, canonical file/publisher trust, no PATH; injectable discovery/trust/process seams для fixtures. Structured result exit/stdout/stderr/timing/cancel; strict documented 0/1 parse, bounded streams. RED для incidental 0/1, nonzero exit, untrusted file, timeout, cancel, malformed/localized date. File version не freshness.
3. [ ] BitLocker SELECT без EncryptionPercentage; GetConversionStatus возвращает progress + return code. Test method denied/missing/failed при сохранённой ProtectionStatus; не трактовать progress как protection.
4. [ ] Local admins collected+no baseline=PolicyMissing. TPM Ready unavailable=Unknown; firmware UnsupportedField/limitations; Windows/KES firewall ownership и conflicts truthful. Normal/admin-denied/conflict/partial fixtures для каждого затронутого source.
5. [ ] Shared deadline default30s; query timeout min(10s,remaining), linked cancellation и bounded process/stream cleanup. Сохранить completed facts; не auto-elevate. Deterministic clock tests для timeout/cancel and late results.
6. [ ] Targeted selftests, evidence safety/redaction, scoring/regression, validators/diff. Root review; один exact-SHA Windows artifact cycle; verify selftest/portable/hash/ZIP/upload. Real Windows11 provider/admin matrix отдельно.

### Approved review corrections
- [ ] Hard deadline must terminate or genuinely bound WMI/native source execution: CT/Task timeout is insufficient. Reuse existing read-only child isolation where needed, bounded kill/cleanup and verified no indefinite background work. Preserve completed partial facts.
- [ ] Timestamp fixtures reject file-version-shaped tokens, ambiguous dates and future source times; no invented definitions freshness.
- [ ] Pin unchanged original scoring formula and partial-observation WARN, particularly TPM present+Ready unknown. Unknown reason metadata must not silently change control verdict.

Delivery budget is authoritative at `/workspace/work/gpc-0171/ci-delivery-route-v2.md`: one required exact-head PR cycle per stage, plus one final all-four-SHA retained-artifact producer. No duplicate intermediate PR+pilot/dispatch. Source publication remains gated by ordered Root requirements and genuine independent quality acceptance. Agent cap9 includes all failed charges and one retained reviewer; concurrency2 permits only one writer plus that reviewer. Prior observer/foreign-gen25 boundary is historical and is superseded only by fresh canonical ownership.

Review focus: repeated-but-low-confidence events, Schannel context, PID reuse, missed metric samples, incompatible/partial snapshot comparison.
1. [ ] Inventory existing commands/snapshots/selftests; map summary/finding stable IDs к existing read-only routes. Navigation fixture pins correct context/module, no collection/remediation side effects on link selection.
2. [ ] Event group key provider+id+deterministic message signature+explicit time window. New grouping helper returns original evidence references/count/time range plus separate impact/confidence. Add top CPU/RAM/IO contributors with stable process identity (PID+start), timing/valid-missed/coverage presentation. """Prepared future project host policy-only CAS preconditions, not activation API."""
import copy
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/work/gpc-2121-runtime/.agents/skills/continuous-development-cycle/scripts')
import budget, execution_lease_v2
from contracts import StrictLoader, digest
import yaml

def validate(old, current, proposed, lease, selected_bytes, semantic_digest,
             expected_revision, actual_revision, expected_source, actual_source):
    if old != current:
        raise ValueError('current complete ledger differs from expected old')
    if expected_revision != actual_revision or expected_source != actual_source:
        raise ValueError('stale coordination/source')
    budget.validate_ledger(current)
    budget.validate_ledger(proposed)
    execution_lease_v2.validate(lease)
    done = {r['grant_id'] for r in lease['submission_resolutions']}
    if lease['owner_id'] is not None or lease['external_guard'] is not None or lease['invocation'] is not None:
        raise ValueError('released/no owner/guard/invocation required')
    if any(c['grant_id'] not in done for c in lease['submission_claims']):
        raise ValueError('unresolved submission claim')
    a = yaml.load(selected_bytes.decode(), Loader=StrictLoader)
    if digest(a) != semantic_digest or a['orchestration']['budget'] != proposed['policy']:
        raise ValueError('selected adapter digest/policy mismatch')
    unchanged = copy.deepcopy(proposed)
    unchanged['policy'] = current['policy']
    unchanged['policy_digest'] = current['policy_digest']
    if unchanged != current:
        raise ValueError('non-policy ledger mutation')
    return True

def publish(host, expected_revision, expected_old, proposed, selected_path, expected_digest, approval):
    import subprocess
    if approval.get('state') != 'APPROVED_FOR_ACTIVATION':
        raise ValueError('explicit reviewed activation required')
    selected_bytes = selected_path.read_bytes()
    import hashlib
    if hashlib.sha256(selected_bytes).hexdigest() != approval['selected_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('selected bytes mismatch')
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', host.S+'/validate_adapter.py', str(selected_path)], capture_output=True, timeout=30)
    if result.returncode:
        raise ValueError('strict adapter validator rejected selection')
    revision, current, lease = host.read()
    validate(expected_old,current,proposed,lease,selected_bytes,expected_digest,
             expected_revision,revision,approval['source'],host.head(host.REF))
    # host.ledger_cas independently rechecks exact COORD and source before push,
    # replaces ONLY budget.json, and requires full new-ledger readback equality.
    return host.ledger_cas(revision,current,proposed,'future-reviewed-policy-transition')

workflow.fulltext:
name: Windows EXE

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'pilot/**'
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: pc-health-check-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  DOTNET_NOLOGO: 'true'
  DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT: 'true'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: E2E PowerShell tools smoke
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $scripts = Get-ChildItem tools/e2e -Filter *.ps1 -File
          if ($scripts.Count -lt 5) { throw "Expected at least 5 E2E PowerShell tools, found $($scripts.Count)." }

          foreach ($script in $scripts) {
            $tokens = $null
            $parseErrors = $null
            [void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($script.FullName, [ref]$tokens, [ref]$parseErrors)
            if (@($parseErrors).Count -gt 0) {
              $details = @($parseErrors) | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Extent.StartLineNumber):$($_.Extent.StartColumnNumber) $($_.Message)" }
              throw "PowerShell parse errors in $($script.Name): $($details -join ' | ')"
            }
          }
          Write-Host "PowerShell parser gate passed for $($scripts.Count) scripts."

          try {
            & pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File .\tools\e2e\Prepare-CleanTempScenario.ps1
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Prepare-CleanTempScenario failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }

            $root = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'GPcHealthCheck-E2E'
            $old = Join-Path $root 'old-delete-me.txt'
            $fresh = Join-Path $root 'fresh-must-stay.txt'
            $manifest = Join-Path $root 'e2e-manifest.json'
            if (-not (Test-Path $old) -or -not (Test-Path $fresh) -or -not (Test-Path $manifest)) {
              throw 'Prepare scenario did not create all required sentinels/manifest.'
            }

            # Simulate only the observable effect of successful CleanTemp on our dedicated old sentinel.
            # The real application's remediation is deliberately not invoked against the shared runner Temp.
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $old -Force
            & pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File .\tools\e2e\Verify-CleanTempScenario.ps1
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Verify-CleanTempScenario failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }

            $evidenceOut = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'gpchc-e2e-evidence'
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $evidenceOut | Out-Null
            & pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File .\tools\e2e\Collect-E2EEvidence.ps1 -OutputDirectory $evidenceOut -LatestReportFiles 2
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Collect-E2EEvidence failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
            $zip = Get-ChildItem $evidenceOut -Filter 'G-PC-Health-E2E-*.zip' -File | Select-Object -First 1
            if ($null -eq $zip -or $zip.Length -le 0) { throw 'Evidence collector did not create a non-empty ZIP.' }
          }
          finally {
            & pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File .\tools\e2e\Cleanup-E2EScenario.ps1
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Cleanup-E2EScenario failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
            if (Test-Path (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'GPcHealthCheck-E2E')) { throw 'E2E Temp root remains after cleanup.' }
          }

          Write-Host 'E2E PowerShell tools smoke passed.'

      - name: PowerShell parser gates
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $targets = @(
            '.\tools\ci\Create-PilotBundle.ps1',
            '.\tools\ci\Test-PortableWorker.ps1',
            '.\tools\branding\Generate-BrandAssets.ps1'
          )
          foreach ($target in $targets) {
            $tokens = $null
            $parseErrors = $null
            [void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile((Resolve-Path $target).Path, [ref]$tokens, [ref]$parseErrors)
            if (@($parseErrors).Count -gt 0) {
              $details = @($parseErrors) | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Extent.StartLineNumber):$($_.Extent.StartColumnNumber) $($_.Message)" }
              throw "PowerShell parse errors in ${target}: $($details -join ' | ')"
            }
          }

      - name: Generate and verify brand assets
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          .\tools\branding\Generate-BrandAssets.ps1
          $shield = '.\src\G.PcHealthCheck\assets\g-shield.png'
          $icon = '.\src\G.PcHealthCheck\assets\gpchc.ico'
          $shieldHash = (Get-FileHash $shield -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          if ($shieldHash -ne '5157c5cf83a6cfddb74c51701a693e401e36b400812505a1e46e15d760c72877') {
            throw "Corporate shield provenance mismatch: $shieldHash"
          }
          if ((Get-Item $icon).Length -lt 4096) { throw 'Generated application icon is unexpectedly small.' }
          Write-Host "Corporate G-switcher shield verified: $shieldHash"

      - name: Setup .NET 8
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@67a3573c9a986a3f9c594539f4ab511d57bb3ce9 # v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.425'

      - name: Restore
        run: dotnet restore src/G.PcHealthCheck/G.PcHealthCheck.csproj

      - name: NuGet vulnerability gate
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $output = dotnet list src/G.PcHealthCheck/G.PcHealthCheck.csproj package --vulnerable --include-transitive --format json
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "NuGet vulnerability audit command failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
          $audit = ($output -join "`n") | ConvertFrom-Json
          $vulnerable = @()
          foreach ($project in @($audit.projects)) {
            foreach ($framework in @($project.frameworks)) {
              foreach ($package in @($framework.topLevelPackages) + @($framework.transitivePackages)) {
                if ($null -ne $package -and @($package.vulnerabilities).Count -gt 0) {
                  $vulnerable += $package
                }
              }
            }
          }
          if ($vulnerable.Count -gt 0) {
            $names = $vulnerable | ForEach-Object { "$($_.id) $($_.resolvedVersion)" }
            throw "Vulnerable NuGet packages detected: $($names -join ', ')"
          }
          Write-Host "NuGet vulnerability gate: no known vulnerable packages."

      - name: Build
        run: dotnet build src/G.PcHealthCheck/G.PcHealthCheck.csproj -c Release --no-restore -warnaserror

      - name: Source-build self-test
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          dotnet run --project src/G.PcHealthCheck/G.PcHealthCheck.csproj -c Release --no-build -- --selftest
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Source-build self-test failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }

      - name: Publish single EXE
        run: dotnet publish src/G.PcHealthCheck/G.PcHealthCheck.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true --no-restore -o artifacts/publish

      - name: Published EXE self-test
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $exe = (Resolve-Path artifacts/publish/G-PC-Health.exe).Path
          $process = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList @('--selftest') -Wait -PassThru
          if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Published single-file EXE self-test failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode)" }
          Write-Host "Published single-file EXE self-test passed."

      - name: Published portable worker and security negative tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          .\tools\ci\Test-PortableWorker.ps1 -ExePath .\artifacts\publish\G-PC-Health.exe

      - name: Verify package, version and checksum
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $exe = Get-Item artifacts/publish/G-PC-Health.exe -ErrorAction Stop
          $unexpected = Get-ChildItem artifacts/publish -File | Where-Object Name -ne 'G-PC-Health.exe'
          if ($unexpected) { throw "Single-file gate failed: $($unexpected.Name -join ', ')" }

          [xml]$project = Get-Content src/G.PcHealthCheck/G.PcHealthCheck.csproj
          $projectVersion = [string]$project.Project.PropertyGroup.Version
          $actualFileVersion = [Version][System.Diagnostics.FileVersionInfo]::GetVersionInfo($exe.FullName).FileVersion
          if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($projectVersion)) { throw 'Project Version is empty.' }
          $expectedFileVersion = [Version]::Parse("$projectVersion.0")
          if ($actualFileVersion -ne $expectedFileVersion) {
            throw "File version mismatch. Expected=$expectedFileVersion EXE=$actualFileVersion"
          }

          $hash = (Get-FileHash $exe.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force artifacts/final | Out-Null
          Copy-Item $exe.FullName artifacts/final/G-PC-Health.exe
          Set-Content artifacts/final/G-PC-Health.exe.sha256 "$hash  G-PC-Health.exe" -Encoding ascii
          Write-Host "Version: $actualFileVersion"
          Write-Host "SHA-256: $hash"

      - name: Create and verify pilot bundle
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          .\tools\ci\Create-PilotBundle.ps1 `
            -ExePath .\artifacts\final\G-PC-Health.exe `
            -ChecksumPath .\artifacts\final\G-PC-Health.exe.sha256 `
            -OutputDirectory .\artifacts\pilot `
            -GitSha $env:GITHUB_SHA

          $pilotZip = Get-ChildItem .\artifacts\pilot -Filter 'G-PC-Health-*-pilot.zip' -File | Select-Object -First 1
          if ($null -eq $pilotZip -or $pilotZip.Length -le 0) { throw 'Pilot bundle ZIP missing or empty.' }

          $verify = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'gpchc-pilot-verify'
          Remove-Item $verify -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $verify | Out-Null
          Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $pilotZip.FullName -DestinationPath $verify -Force

          $manifest = Get-Content (Join-Path $verify 'package-manifest.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          $packagedExe = Join-Path $verify 'G-PC-Health.exe'
          if (-not (Test-Path $packagedExe -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Packaged EXE missing.' }
          $packagedHash = (Get-FileHash $packagedExe -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          if ($packagedHash -ne [string]$manifest.sha256) { throw 'Packaged EXE hash does not match package manifest.' }
          if ([string]$manifest.gitSha -ne $env:GITHUB_SHA) { throw 'Package manifest Git SHA mismatch.' }
          if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $verify 'START-HERE.txt'))) { throw 'START-HERE.txt missing.' }
          if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $verify 'docs\E2E-TEST-PLAN.md'))) { throw 'E2E test plan missing.' }
          if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $verify 'e2e\Analyze-E2EEvidence.ps1'))) { throw 'Evidence analyzer missing.' }
          $toolCount = @(Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $verify 'e2e') -Filter '*.ps1' -File).Count
          if ($toolCount -lt 5) { throw "Expected at least 5 E2E tools in pilot bundle, found $toolCount." }
          $strictUtf8Bom = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($true, $true)
          $startHereText = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $verify 'START-HERE.txt'), $strictUtf8Bom)
          if (-not $startHereText.Contains('Сверьте SHA-256') -or -not $startHereText.Contains('Диагностику можно запускать')) {
            throw 'Packaged START-HERE strict UTF-8 verification failed.'
          }
          if ($manifest.trustedRemediationPath -ne $null -or -not $manifest.portableElevation -or $manifest.executableNameRestricted) {
            throw 'Pilot manifest still restricts portable elevation.'
          }
          Write-Host "Pilot bundle verified: $($pilotZip.Name)"

      - name: Upload EXE
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: g-pc-health-check-windows-x64
          path: artifacts/final/*
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Upload pilot E2E bundle
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: g-pc-health-check-pilot-e2e
          path: artifacts/pilot/G-PC-Health-*-pilot.zip
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

В момент каждого будущего эффекта нужны fresh source, runtime, ownership, guard и budget. Immutable CDC не менять.

## 0.17.1 — читаемый UI
В MainStrings.resx и MainStrings.en.resx заменить literal backslash+n настоящими переносами только в семи ключах каждого языка: Main.Message.Blocked; Main.Message.Confirm; Main.Message.Completed; Main.ExecutionContext.ProcessSession; Main.ExecutionContext.ScopeTooltip; Main.ExecutionContext.ActionScope; Main.ServiceDesk.RecommendedUnavailable. Итого 14 entries. Сохранить placeholders; не делать global/runtime unescape.
Findings — основная область; actions компактны, кнопки называют конкретное действие. Details selectable, scrollable, copyable. Семь metrics адаптируются к ширине, security coverage всегда доступна, RAM warning понятен. Splitter пропорциональный с минимумами обеих панелей. Проверить auxiliary dialogs: resize, DPI, RU/EN, RDP, keyboard/focus. Не менять action IDs, confirmation/UAC, execution order.

## 0.17.2 — отчёт и сортировки
Порядок: summary → findings → actions → security → processes/events → system/context. Общая semantic status/risk display order для UI/report; localized human control names при неизменных stable IDs. Unknown — verify-first, не healthy/failure и не разрешение исправлять. Anchors, responsive и print layout. Сохранить numeric sorting, selection identity, исходные facts, encoding/redaction. Display order никогда не меняет DISM→SFC execution.

## 0.18.0 — достоверный сбор ИБ
Typed Unknown reasons: RightsRequired, SourceUnavailable, Timeout, QueryError, PolicyMissing, UnsupportedField, SourceConflict. Cancellation отдельно от причины Unknown; partial facts сохраняются. Evidence хранит source, observation time, trustworthy source time если доступно, exit/return code и отдельно redacted stdout/stderr. Raw sensitive output не попадает в UI/report/exports.
Собранные facts отдельно от verdict. Существующая формула сохраняется: score = earned weight / known applicable weight; coverage = known applicable weight / all applicable weight; all-unknown score=null; N/A исключается. Нельзя улучшать оценку выдуманными facts.
KES: находить реально установленный CLI через documented install locations и registry (32/64-bit views); не arbitrary PATH. Перед запуском canonical absolute path, trusted file/publisher и допустимый fixed read-only argv. Раздельные exit/stdout/stderr, strict documented 0/1 payload parser; случайный token в diagnostic output не считается состоянием. Timeout/cancel, bounded output. Freshness только по достоверному definitions timestamp; file version — отдельный version fact, не свежесть.
BitLocker: убрать EncryptionPercentage из WMI SELECT, получать progress через GetConversionStatus; сохранять return code и права. ProtectionStatus отдельно от progress. Ошибка progress не удаляет успешно собранную protection evidence.
Local admins: полученный список без baseline → PolicyMissing, не collectorFailure. TPM Ready unknown и Windows firmware limitations показывать честно. Firewall Windows/KES/provider conflict различать; не приписывать состояние стороннего firewall Windows.
Общий deadline и cancellation: планируемый default 30s, KES query не более существующих 10s и остатка общего бюджета; bounded cleanup без бесконечного ожидания streams. Никакого automatic UAC, remediation или изменения защиты.
Fixtures: normal, admin-denied, conflict, timeout, partial, localized output; дополнительно cancellation, untrusted executable, malformed timestamps, missing baseline и sensitive redaction.

## 0.19.0 — углублённая read-only диагностика
Переиспользовать ProcessObservation, PerformanceSession, IncidentReview, StorageReview, EndpointReview, StartupReview; не создавать альтернативные collectors. Из summary/finding переходить к соответствующей read-only диагностике с исходным context.
Повторяющиеся события группировать по provider/id/message signature/time window. Frequency отдельно от impact/confidence; высокий count сам по себе не CRIT. Schannel не объявлять безвредным без контекстной evidence. Подпись детерминирована, original evidence сохраняется, redaction не раскрывает секреты.
Короткая CPU/RAM/IO session: использовать существующий default 120s/2s, hard existing bound 600s; cancellation. Показывать top contributors, фактические start/end, sample interval, valid/missed samples, coverage; отсутствующая метрика Unknown, не ноль. Не смешивать process identity после PID reuse.
Сравнение двух снимков: new/resolved/changed, schema version и source/completeness metadata. Stable item identities и совместимые schema; unavailable/incomplete observation не превращает исчезнувшую запись в resolved. Unsupported schema → явная невозможность сравнить, не пустой delta.
Детерминированные clock/source fixtures, UI/report parity и сохранение read-only boundaries.

## Уже реализовано и новые изменения — inspected source
SecurityPostureEvaluator.cs уже считает known-subset score/coverage и AssessmentIncomplete при coverage<80. SecurityPostureModels.cs уже разделяет snapshot/assessment, но SecurityEvidence содержит только Key/Value/Source — новые typed reasons/time/exit metadata нужны.
KasperskySecurityReader.cs уже использует два ProgramFiles locations, fixed OPSWAT queries и 10s timeout, не PATH. Не реализованы registry discovery/trust gate/structured execution result; stdout+stderr сейчас объединяются, exit не возвращается, RTP parser принимает любой найденный 0/1.
BitLockerSecurityCollector.cs уже отделяет protection/conversion status, но SELECT содержит EncryptionPercentage и progress читается как property — исправить query/method и partial evidence.
LocalAdministratorsCollector/Policy уже отдельны; требуется закрепить PolicyMissing при успешно полученном списке. WindowsPlatformSecurityCollector/FirmwareSecurityCollector имеют nullable observations/provider constraints — расширить причины и отображение, не переписать verdict с нуля.
Существуют перечисленные шесть диагностических модулей и их selftests. PerformanceSessionCore уже имеет duration/interval bounds, cancellation и completeness. Новое: summary navigation, event grouping semantics, contributor presentation и versioned cross-snapshot delta. Наличие модулей не доказывает выполнение всей новой acceptance matrix.

## Delivery, budgets и project gates
Четыре новые необходимые Windows test artifact cycles планируются, не запускаются. Существующий ledger/task/events/outcomes не обнулять. Explicit reviewed budget migration сохраняет charges/circuits; exact candidate/attempt bindings и durable reservation/readback перед эффектами. Нельзя потратить второй цикл через PR+pilot duplicate trigger. Provider quotas unknown без actual observation.
Каждый этап: targeted RED/GREEN, bounded diff/validators, один exact-SHA Windows artifact cycle, selftest/portable/version/checksum/pilot ZIP/upload/delivery, transactional executor release. Hosted Windows не означает real Windows11 GUI/UAC/RDP acceptance. Merge/main/production release только после real Windows11 pilot и explicit owner integration approval. Watchdog остаётся paused.

Budget proposal: preserve two existing charged CI cycles; four new artifact Windows cycles plus at most one required final-PR exact-head cycle, total task cap 7. Actions conserve; max one cycle per logical stage/final acceptance, no intermediate PR+pilot duplicate. Apply migration only after this executor has fresh managed ownership, not during foreign gen25. No restoration of exhausted policy and no ledger reset.

KES timestamp rejects version tokens, ambiguous and future dates. Preserve original scoring formula and WARN on partial observations, including TPM present+Ready unknown.
0.19: 120s/2s means actual sampling, not immediate certainty. Bound top contributor count; identity PID+starttime; missing samples stay Unknown, never fabricated zero.

"""Project host admission checks; never starts a worker or changes policy."""
import hashlib, json, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

S = '/workspace/work/gpc-2121-runtime/.agents/skills/continuous-development-cycle/scripts'
sys.path.insert(0, S)
import yaml
from contracts import StrictLoader, digest
import budget, execution_lease_v2

def check(journal, adapter_bytes, ledger, lease, source, *, admission=None):
    if journal.get('state') != 'ACTIVE' or journal.get('policy_activated') is not True:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: migration is not ACTIVE')
    if journal.get('qualified_quality') != 'ACCEPTED' or journal.get('root_activation') != 'APPROVED':
        raise ValueError('launch denied: qualified review/root activation missing')
    if hashlib.sha256(adapter_bytes).hexdigest() != journal['selected_adapter_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: selected adapter bytes mismatch')
    adapter = yaml.load(adapter_bytes.decode(), Loader=StrictLoader)
    if digest(adapter) != journal['selected_adapter_semantic_digest']:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: adapter semantic digest mismatch')
    budget.validate_ledger(ledger)
    execution_lease_v2.validate(lease)
    if adapter['orchestration']['budget'] != ledger['policy']:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: adapter/current ledger policy mismatch')
    if ledger['policy_digest'] != journal['new_budget_digest']:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: current budget digest mismatch')
    if source != journal['source']:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: fresh source mismatch')
    resolved = {r['grant_id'] for r in lease['submission_resolutions']}
    if lease['external_guard'] is not None or any(c['grant_id'] not in resolved for c in lease['submission_claims']):
        raise ValueError('launch denied: boundary is guarded/pending')
    admission = admission or {'role': 'writer'}
    if admission.get('role') == 'writer':
        if lease['owner_id'] is not None or lease['invocation'] is not None:
            raise ValueError('launch denied: writer requires released boundary')
    elif admission.get('role') == 'read_only':
        approved = journal.get('approved_review_binding')
        if not isinstance(approved, dict):
            raise ValueError('launch denied: durable approved review binding missing')
        encoded = json.dumps(approved, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()
        if (hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest() != journal.get('approved_review_binding_sha256')
                or journal.get('root_spec_disposition') != 'ACCEPTED'
                or journal.get('policy_quality_disposition') != 'ACCEPTED'
                or approved.get('transport') != 'collaboration.spawn_agent'
                or admission.get('transport') != 'collaboration.spawn_agent'):
            raise ValueError('launch denied: approved binding/dispositions/transport mismatch')
        for key in ('role','purpose','candidate_sha','parent_owner_id','parent_generation',
                    'parent_invocation_id','handle_root','handle_id','attempt_id','operation_key'):
            if key not in approved or admission.get(key) != approved[key]:
                raise ValueError('launch denied: caller differs from durable approved binding')
        if (admission.get('purpose') != 'exact_candidate_quality'
                or admission.get('candidate_sha') != journal.get('review_candidate_sha')
                or admission.get('candidate_sha') != admission.get('observed_candidate_sha')
                or not admission.get('candidate_sha')
                or admission.get('parent_owner_id') != lease['owner_id']
                or admission.get('parent_generation') != lease['generation']
                or admission.get('parent_invocation_id') != (lease.get('invocation') or {}).get('invocation_id')
                or lease['owner_id'] is None
                or admission.get('parent_runtime_status') != 'running'
                or admission.get('parent_scope') != 'writer'):
            raise ValueError('launch denied: authentic held writer/candidate/purpose binding mismatch')
    else:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: unsupported role')
    return {'preflight_allowed': True, 'authorizes_launch': False,
            'note': 'Separate budget reservation and canonical pool claim remain required'}

def run(repo_host, journal_store, adapter_path, *, review_binding=None):
    """Actual fresh readback route, to be invoked at every future launch boundary."""
    revision, journal = journal_store.read()
    if revision is None:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: durable journal missing')
    adapter_path = Path(adapter_path)
    argv = [sys.executable, '-B', S + '/validate_adapter.py', str(adapter_path)]
    result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    if result.returncode:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: strict adapter validator rejected selection')
    coord, ledger, lease = repo_host.read()
    source = repo_host.head(repo_host.REF)
    admission = None
    if review_binding is not None:
        approved = journal.get('approved_review_binding')
        if not isinstance(approved, dict):
            raise ValueError('launch denied: durable approved review binding missing')
        if any(review_binding.get(k) != v for k, v in approved.items()):
            raise ValueError('launch denied: supplied binding differs from durable approval')
        # Recover genuine existing managed parent; never acquire/renew its lease.
        session = repo_host.bridge._load_session(approved['handle_root'], approved['handle_id'])
        runtime = repo_host.bridge._runtime(session)
        observation = runtime.observe(session['task_id'], session['attempt_id'])
        candidate, _, _ = repo_host.bridge._result(session, runtime)
        admission = {**approved, 'observed_candidate_sha': candidate,
                     'parent_runtime_status': observation['status'],
                     'parent_scope': repo_host.bridge._task(session['plan'],session['task_id'])['role']}
        if (session['owner_id'] != review_binding['parent_owner_id']
                or session['generation'] != review_binding['parent_generation']
                or session['invocation_id'] != review_binding['parent_invocation_id']):
            raise ValueError('launch denied: parent handle identity mismatch')
    answer = check(journal, adapter_path.read_bytes(), ledger, lease, source, admission=admission)
    if journal_store.read()[0] != revision or repo_host.head(repo_host.COORD) != coord:
        raise ValueError('launch denied: control state moved during preflight')
    return {**answer, 'journal_revision': revision, 'coordination': coord,
            'validator_argv': argv, 'validator_exit': result.returncode}

def policy_projection(current, proposed_policy):
    """Replace policy only in the ACTUAL current full ledger, not an old template."""
    import copy
    budget.validate_ledger(current)
    result = copy.deepcopy(current)
    result['policy'] = copy.deepcopy(proposed_policy)
    result['policy_digest'] = budget._digest(proposed_policy)
    budget.validate_ledger(result)
    assert result['events'] == current['events']
    assert result['wake_ids'] == current['wake_ids']
    assert result['task_id'] == current['task_id']
    return result

upload-README.md.text: # `@actions/upload-artifact` > [!WARNING] > actions/upload-artifact@v3 is scheduled for deprecation on **November 30, 2024**. [Learn more.](https://github.blog/changelog/2024-04-16-deprecation-notice-v3-of-the-artifact-actions/) > Similarly, v1/v2 are scheduled for deprecation on **June 30, 2024**. > Please update your workflow to use v4 of the artifact actions. > This deprecation will not impact any existing versions of GitHub Enterprise Server being used by customers. Upload [Actions Artifacts](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-workflows/storing-workflow-data-as-artifacts) from your Workflow Runs. Internally powered by [@actions/artifact](https://github.com/actions/toolkit/tree/main/packages/artifact) package. See also [download-artifact](https://github.com/actions/download-artifact). - [`@actions/upload-artifact`](#actionsupload-artifact) - [v4 - What's new](#v4---whats-new) - [Improvements](#improvements) - [Breaking Changes](#breaking-changes) - [Usage](#usage) - [Inputs](#inputs) - [Outputs](#outputs) - [Examples](#examples) - [Upload an Individual File](#upload-an-individual-file) - [Upload an Entire Directory](#upload-an-entire-directory) - [Upload using a Wildcard Pattern](#upload-using-a-wildcard-pattern) - [Upload using Multiple Paths and Exclusions](#upload-using-multiple-paths-and-exclusions) - [Altering compressions level (speed v. size)](#altering-compressions-level-speed-v-size) - [Customization if no files are found](#customization-if-no-files-are-found) - [(Not) Uploading to the same artifact](#not-uploading-to-the-same-artifact) - [Environment Variables and Tilde Expansion](#environment-variables-and-tilde-expansion) - [Retention Period](#retention-period) - [Using Outputs](#using-outputs) - [Example output between steps](#example-output-between-steps) - [Example output between jobs](#example-output-between-jobs) - [Overwriting an Artifact](#overwriting-an-artifact) - [Limitations](#limitations) - [Number of Artifacts](#number-of-artifacts) - [Zip archives](#zip-archives) - [Permission Loss](#permission-loss) - [Where does the upload go?](#where-does-the-upload-go) ## v4 - What's new > [!IMPORTANT] > upload-artifact@v4+ is not currently supported on GHES yet. If you are on GHES, you must use [v3](https://github.com/actions/upload-artifact/releases/tag/v3). The release of upload-artifact@v4 and download-artifact@v4 are major changes to the backend architecture of Artifacts. They have numerous performance and behavioral improvements. For more information, see the [`@actions/artifact`](https://github.com/actions/toolkit/tree/main/packages/artifact) documentation. There is also a new sub-action, `actions/upload-artifact/merge`. For more info, check out that action's [README](./merge/README.md). ### Improvements 1. Uploads are significantly faster, upwards of 90% improvement in worst case scenarios. 2. Once uploaded, an Artifact ID is returned and Artifacts are immediately available in the UI and [REST API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/artifacts). Previously, you would have to wait for the run to be completed before an ID was available or any APIs could be utilized. 3. The contents of an Artifact are uploaded together into an _immutable_ archive. They cannot be altered by subsequent jobs unless the Artifacts are deleted and recreated (where they will have a new ID). Both of these factors help reduce the possibility of accidentally corrupting Artifact files. 4. The compression level of an Artifact can be manually tweaked for speed or size reduction. ### Breaking Changes 1. On self hosted runners, additional [firewall rules](https://github.com/actions/toolkit/tree/main/packages/artifact#breaking-changes) may be required. 2. Uploading to the same named Artifact multiple times. Due to how Artifacts are created in this new version, it is no longer possible to upload to the same named Artifact multiple times. You must either split the uploads into multiple Artifacts with different names, or only upload once. Otherwise you _will_ encounter an error. 3. Limit of Artifacts for an individual job. Each job in a workflow run now has a limit of 500 artifacts. 4. With `v4.4` and later, hidden files are excluded by default. For assistance with breaking changes, see [MIGRATION.md](docs/MIGRATION.md). ## Usage ### Inputs ```yaml - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: # Name of the artifact to upload. # Optional. Default is 'artifact' name: # A file, directory or wildcard pattern that describes what to upload # Required. path: # The desired behavior if no files are found using the provided path. # Available Options: # warn: Output a warning but do not fail the action # error: Fail the action with an error message # ignore: Do not output any warnings or errors, the action does not fail # Optional. Default is 'warn' if-no-files-found: # Duration after which artifact will expire in days. 0 means using default retention. # Minimum 1 day. # Maximum 90 days unless changed from the repository settings page. # Optional. Defaults to repository settings. retention-days: # The level of compression for Zlib to be applied to the artifact archive. # The value can range from 0 to 9. # For large files that are not easily compressed, a value of 0 is recommended for significantly faster uploads. # Optional. Default is '6' compression-level: # If true, an artifact with a matching name will be deleted before a new one is uploaded. # If false, the action will fail if an artifact for the given name already exists. # Does not fail if the artifact does not exist. # Optional. Default is 'false' overwrite: # Whether to include hidden files in the provided path in the artifact # The file contents of any hidden files in the path should be validated before # enabled this to avoid uploading sensitive information. # Optional. Default is 'false' include-hidden-files: ``` ### Outputs | Name | Description | Example | | - | - | - | | `artifact-id` | GitHub ID of an Artifact, can be used by the REST API | `1234` | | `artifact-url` | URL to download an Artifact. Can be used in many scenarios such as linking to artifacts in issues or pull requests. Users must be logged-in in order for this URL to work. This URL is valid as long as the artifact has not expired or the artifact, run or repository have not been deleted | `https://github.com/example-org/example-repo/actions/runs/1/artifacts/1234` | | `artifact-digest` | SHA-256 digest of an Artifact | 0fde654d4c6e659b45783a725dc92f1bfb0baa6c2de64b34e814dc206ff4aaaf | ## Examples ### Upload an Individual File ```yaml steps: - run: mkdir -p path/to/artifact - run: echo hello > path/to/artifact/world.txt - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: my-artifact path: path/to/artifact/world.txt ``` ### Upload an Entire Directory ```yaml - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: my-artifact path: path/to/artifact/ # or path/to/artifact ``` ### Upload using a Wildcard Pattern ```yaml - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: my-artifact path: path/**/[abc]rtifac?/* ``` ### Upload using Multiple Paths and Exclusions ```yaml - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: my-artifact path: | path/output/bin/ path/output/test-results !path/**/*.tmp ``` For supported wildcards along with behavior and documentation, see [@actions/glob](https://github.com/actions/toolkit/tree/main/packages/glob) which is used internally to search for files. If a wildcard pattern is used, the path hierarchy will be preserved after the first wildcard pattern: ``` path/to/*/directory/foo?.txt => ∟ path/to/some/directory/foo1.txt ∟ path/to/some/directory/foo2.txt ∟ path/to/other/directory/foo1.txt would be flattened and uploaded as => ∟ some/directory/foo1.txt ∟ some/directory/foo2.txt ∟ other/directory/foo1.txt ``` If multiple paths are provided as input, the least common ancestor of all the search paths will be used as the root directory of the artifact. Exclude paths do not affect the directory structure. Relative and absolute file paths are both allowed. Relative paths are rooted against the current working directory. Paths that begin with a wildcard character should be quoted to avoid being interpreted as YAML aliases. ### Altering compressions level (speed v. size) If you are uploading large or easily compressable data to your artifact, you may benefit from tweaking the compression level. By default, the compression level is `6`, the same as GNU Gzip. The value can range from 0 to 9: - 0: No compression - 1: Best speed - 6: Default compression (same as GNU Gzip) - 9: Best compression Higher levels will result in better compression, but will take longer to complete. For large files that are not easily compressed, a value of `0` is recommended for significantly faster uploads. For instance, if you are uploading random binary data, you can save a lot of time by opting out of compression completely, since it won't benefit: ```yaml - name: Make a 1GB random binary file run: | dd if=/dev/urandom of=my-1gb-file bs=1M count=1000 - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: my-artifact path: my-1gb-file compression-level: 0 # no compression ``` But, if you are uploading data that is easily compressed (like plaintext, code, etc) you can save space and cost by having a higher compression level. But this will be heavier on the CPU therefore slower to upload: ```yaml - name: Make a file with a lot of repeated text run: | for i in {1..100000}; do echo -n 'foobar' >> foobar.txt; done - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: my-artifact path: foobar.txt compression-level: 9 # maximum compression ``` ### Customization if no files are found If a path (or paths), result in no files being found for the artifact, the action will succeed but print out a warning. In certain scenarios it may be desirable to fail the action or suppress the warning. The `if-no-files-found` option allows you to customize the behavior of the action if no files are found: ```yaml - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: my-artifact path: path/to/artifact/ if-no-files-found: error # 'warn' or 'ignore' are also available, defaults to `warn` ``` ### (Not) Uploading to the same artifact Unlike earlier versions of `upload-artifact`, uploading to the same artifact via multiple jobs is _not_ supported with `v4`. ```yaml - run: echo hi > world.txt - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: # implicitly named as 'artifact' path: world.txt - run: echo howdy > extra-file.txt - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: # also implicitly named as 'artifact', will fail here! path: extra-file.txt ``` Artifact names must be unique since each created artifact is idempotent so multiple jobs cannot modify the same artifact. In matrix scenarios, be careful to not accidentally upload to the same artifact, or else you will encounter conflict errors. It would be best to name the artifact _with_ a prefix or suffix from the matrix: ```yaml jobs: upload: name: Generate Build Artifacts strategy: matrix: os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest] version: [a, b, c] runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }} steps: - name: Build run: ./some-script --version=${{ matrix.version }} > my-binary - name: Upload uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: binary-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.version }} path: my-binary ``` This will result in artifacts like: `binary-ubuntu-latest-a`, `binary-windows-latest-b`, and so on. Previously the behavior _allowed_ for the artifact names to be the same which resulted in unexpected mutations and accidental corruption. Artifacts created by upload-artifact@v4 are immutable. ### Environment Variables and Tilde Expansion You can use `~` in the path input as a substitute for `$HOME`. Basic tilde expansion is supported: ```yaml - run: | mkdir -p ~/new/artifact echo hello > ~/new/artifact/world.txt - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: my-artifacts path: ~/new/**/* ``` Environment variables along with context expressions can also be used for input. For documentation see [context and expression syntax](https://help.github.com/en/actions/reference/context-and-expression-syntax-for-github-actions): ```yaml env: name: my-artifact steps: - run: | mkdir -p ${{ github.workspace }}/artifact echo hello > ${{ github.workspace }}/artifact/world.txt - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: ${{ env.name }}-name path: ${{ github.workspace }}/artifact/**/* ``` For environment variables created in other steps, make sure to use the `env` expression syntax ```yaml steps: - run: | mkdir testing echo "This is a file to upload" > testing/file.txt echo "artifactPath=testing/file.txt" >> $GITHUB_ENV - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: artifact path: ${{ env.artifactPath }} # this will resolve to testing/file.txt at runtime ``` ### Retention Period Artifacts are retained for 90 days by default. You can specify a shorter retention period using the `retention-days` input: ```yaml - name: Create a file run: echo "I won't live long" > my_file.txt - name: Upload Artifact uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: my-artifact path: my_file.txt retention-days: 5 ``` The retention period must be between 1 and 90 inclusive. For more information see [artifact and log retention policies](https://docs.github.com/en/free-pro-team@latest/actions/reference/usage-limits-billing-and-administration#artifact-and-log-retention-policy). ### Using Outputs If an artifact upload is successful then an `artifact-id` output is available. This ID is a unique identifier that can be used with [Artifact REST APIs](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/artifacts). #### Example output between steps ```yml - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 id: artifact-upload-step with: name: my-artifact path: path/to/artifact/content/ - name: Output artifact ID run: echo 'Artifact ID is ${{ steps.artifact-upload-step.outputs.artifact-id }}' ``` #### Example output between jobs ```yml jobs: job1: runs-on: ubuntu-latest outputs: output1: ${{ steps.artifact-upload-step.outputs.artifact-id }} steps: - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 id: artifact-upload-step with: name: my-artifact path: path/to/artifact/content/ job2: runs-on: ubuntu-latest needs: job1 steps: - env: OUTPUT1: ${{needs.job1.outputs.output1}} run: echo "Artifact ID from previous job is $OUTPUT1" ``` ### Overwriting an Artifact Although it's not possible to mutate an Artifact, can completely overwrite one. But do note that this will give the Artifact a new ID, the previous one will no longer exist: ```yaml jobs: upload: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - name: Create a file run: echo "hello world" > my-file.txt - name: Upload Artifact uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: my-artifact # NOTE: same artifact name path: my-file.txt upload-again: needs: upload runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - name: Create a different file run: echo "goodbye world" > my-file.txt - name: Upload Artifact uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: my-artifact # NOTE: same artifact name path: my-file.txt overwrite: true ``` ### Uploading Hidden Files By default, hidden files are ignored by this action to avoid unintentionally uploading sensitive information. If you need to upload hidden files, you can use the `include-hidden-files` input. Any files that contain sensitive information that should not be in the uploaded artifact can be excluded using the `path`: ```yaml - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: my-artifact include-hidden-files: true path: | path/output/ !path/output/.production.env ``` Hidden files are defined as any file beginning with `.` or files within folders beginning with `.`. On Windows, files and directories with the hidden attribute are not considered hidden files unless they have the `.` prefix. ## Limitations ### Number of Artifacts Within an individual job, there is a limit of 500 artifacts that can be created for that job. You may also be limited by Artifacts if you have exceeded your shared storage quota. Storage is calculated every 6-12 hours. See [the documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/billing/managing-billing-for-github-actions/about-billing-for-github-actions#calculating-minute-and-storage-spending) for more info. ### Zip archives When an Artifact is uploaded, all the files are assembled into an immutable Zip archive. There is currently no way to download artifacts in a format other than a Zip or to download individual artifact contents. ### Permission Loss File permissions are not maintained during artifact upload. All directories will have `755` and all files will have `644`. For example, if you make a file executable using `chmod` and then upload that file, post-download the file is no longer guaranteed to be set as an executable. If you must preserve permissions, you can `tar` all of your files together before artifact upload. Post download, the `tar` file will maintain file permissions and case sensitivity. ```yaml - name: 'Tar files' run: tar -cvf my_files.tar /path/to/my/directory - name: 'Upload Artifact' uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: my-artifact path: my_files.tar ``` ## Where does the upload go? At the bottom of the workflow summary page, there is a dedicated section for artifacts. Here's a screenshot of something you might see: There is a trashcan icon that can be used to delete the artifact. This icon will only appear for users who have write permissions to the repository. The size of the artifact is denoted in bytes. The displayed artifact size denotes the size of the zip that `upload-artifact` creates during upload.

# G PC Health — spec четырёх этапов, 08.10.2026

## Authority и текущая граница
Owner «Делай все релизы» утверждает дизайн и последовательность. Сейчас observer-only: только внешние документы, root review перед product effects; повторное согласование дизайна не требуется. Порядок 0.17.1 → 0.17.2 → 0.18.0 → 0.19.0, последовательно в этой существующей задаче, без subagents/new tasks/schedulers.
Inspected source: 9dac2653ca1e2d9c66a18505b15cb465f485ed04. Последний прочитанный coordination: 1e8149793d8fe0c21b39386e64e960424d5dedd4, чужой owned gen25 bb41abbc-4b1f-470b-8aaf-1ecdf2e53747; его lease/claims/handle не изменять. В момент каждого будущего эффекта нужны fresh source, runtime, ownership, guard и budget. Immutable CDC не менять.

## 0.17.1 — читаемый UI
В MainStrings.resx и MainStrings.en.resx заменить literal backslash+n настоящими переносами только в семи ключах каждого языка: Main.Message.Blocked; Main.Message.Confirm; Main.Message.Completed; Main.ExecutionContext.ProcessSession; Main.ExecutionContext.ScopeTooltip; Main.ExecutionContext.ActionScope; Main.ServiceDesk.RecommendedUnavailable. Итого 14 entries. Сохранить placeholders; не делать global/runtime unescape.
Findings — основная область; actions компактны, кнопки называют конкретное действие. Details selectable, scrollable, copyable. Семь metrics адаптируются к ширине, security coverage всегда доступна, RAM warning понятен. Splitter пропорциональный с минимумами обеих панелей. Проверить auxiliary dialogs: resize, DPI, RU/EN, RDP, keyboard/focus. Не менять action IDs, confirmation/UAC, execution order.

## 0.17.2 — отчёт и сортировки
Порядок: summary → findings → actions → security → processes/events → system/context. Общая semantic status/risk display order для UI/report; localized human control names при неизменных stable IDs. Unknown — verify-first, не healthy/failure и не разрешение исправлять. Anchors, responsive и print layout. Сохранить numeric sorting, selection identity, исходные facts, encoding/redaction. Display order никогда не меняет DISM→SFC execution.

## 0.18.0 — достоверный сбор ИБ
Typed Unknown reasons: RightsRequired, SourceUnavailable, Timeout, QueryError, PolicyMissing, UnsupportedField, SourceConflict. Cancellation отдельно от причины Unknown; partial facts сохраняются. Evidence хранит source, observation time, trustworthy source time если доступно, exit/return code и отдельно redacted stdout/stderr. Raw sensitive output не попадает в UI/report/exports.
Собранные facts отдельно от verdict. Существующая формула сохраняется: score = earned weight / known applicable weight; coverage = known applicable weight / all applicable weight; all-unknown score=null; N/A исключается. Нельзя улучшать оценку выдуманными facts.
KES: находить реально установленный CLI через documented install locations и registry (32/64-bit views); не arbitrary PATH. Перед запуском canonical absolute path, trusted file/publisher и допустимый fixed read-only argv. Раздельные exit/stdout/stderr, strict documented 0/1 payload parser; случайный token в diagnostic output не считается состоянием. Timeout/cancel, bounded output. Freshness только по достоверному definitions timestamp; file version — отдельный version fact, не свежесть.
BitLocker: убрать EncryptionPercentage из WMI SELECT, получать progress через GetConversionStatus; сохранять return code и права. ProtectionStatus отдельно от progress. Ошибка progress не удаляет успешно собранную protection evidence.
Local admins: полученный список без baseline → PolicyMissing, не collectorFailure. TPM Ready unknown и Windows firmware limitations показывать честно. Firewall Windows/KES/provider conflict различать; не приписывать состояние стороннего firewall Windows.
Общий deadline и cancellation: планируемый default 30s, KES query не более существующих 10s и остатка общего бюджета; bounded cleanup без бесконечного ожидания streams. Никакого automatic UAC, remediation или изменения защиты.
Fixtures: normal, admin-denied, conflict, timeout, partial, localized output; дополнительно cancellation, untrusted executable, malformed timestamps, missing baseline и sensitive redaction.

## 0.19.0 — углублённая read-only диагностика
Переиспользовать ProcessObservation, PerformanceSession, IncidentReview, StorageReview, EndpointReview, StartupReview; не создавать альтернативные collectors. Из summary/finding переходить к соответствующей read-only диагностике с исходным context.
Повторяющиеся события группировать по provider/id/message signature/time window. Frequency отдельно от impact/confidence; высокий count сам по себе не CRIT. Schannel не объявлять безвредным без контекстной evidence. Подпись детерминирована, original evidence сохраняется, redaction не раскрывает секреты.
Короткая CPU/RAM/IO session: использовать существующий default 120s/2s, hard existing bound 600s; cancellation. Показывать top contributors, фактические start/end, sample interval, valid/missed samples, coverage; отсутствующая метрика Unknown, не ноль. Не смешивать process identity после PID reuse.
Сравнение двух снимков: new/resolved/changed, schema version и source/completeness metadata. Stable item identities и совместимые schema; unavailable/incomplete observation не превращает исчезнувшую запись в resolved. Unsupported schema → явная невозможность сравнить, не пустой delta.
Детерминированные clock/source fixtures, UI/report parity и сохранение read-only boundaries.

## Уже реализовано и новые изменения — inspected source
SecurityPostureEvaluator.cs уже считает known-subset score/coverage и AssessmentIncomplete при coverage<80. SecurityPostureModels.cs уже разделяет snapshot/assessment, но SecurityEvidence содержит только Key/Value/Source — новые typed reasons/time/exit metadata нужны.
KasperskySecurityReader.cs уже использует два ProgramFiles locations, fixed OPSWAT queries и 10s timeout, не PATH. Не реализованы registry discovery/trust gate/structured execution result; stdout+stderr сейчас объединяются, exit не возвращается, RTP parser принимает любой найденный 0/1.
BitLockerSecurityCollector.cs уже отделяет protection/conversion status, но SELECT содержит EncryptionPercentage и progress читается как property — исправить query/method и partial evidence.
LocalAdministratorsCollector/Policy уже отдельны; требуется закрепить PolicyMissing при успешно полученном списке. WindowsPlatformSecurityCollector/FirmwareSecurityCollector имеют nullable observations/provider constraints — расширить причины и отображение, не переписать verdict с нуля.
Существуют перечисленные шесть диагностических модулей и их selftests. PerformanceSessionCore уже имеет duration/interval bounds, cancellation и completeness. Новое: summary navigation, event grouping semantics, contributor presentation и versioned cross-snapshot delta. Наличие модулей не доказывает выполнение всей новой acceptance matrix.

## Delivery, budgets и project gates
Четыре новые необходимые Windows test artifact cycles планируются, не запускаются. Существующий ledger/task/events/outcomes не обнулять. Explicit reviewed budget migration сохраняет charges/circuits; exact candidate/attempt bindings и durable reservation/readback перед эффектами. Нельзя потратить второй цикл через PR+pilot duplicate trigger. Provider quotas unknown без actual observation.

Bounded independent FULL QUALITY review complete. **Original packet `84a64bc…`: REQUEST_CHANGES. Prospectively corrected controls and forward strategy: qualified ACCEPTED as preparation only.** Product Q5 acceptance, Windows validation, release readiness, and future-start authorization remain ungranted.

| Scope | Verdict |
|---|---|
| Temporary cap10/CI7, parallel2→3 exception for this ONE reviewer | **Qualified ACCEPTED** |
| Original cap13 migration/preflight at `84a64bc…` | **REQUEST_CHANGES** |
| Corrected prospective admission and policy-transition controls through `547daf4…` | **Qualified ACCEPTED**, pending actual activation/integration |
| Q5 correction and referenced cycle3 strategy | **Qualified ACCEPTED as strategy/draft**; corrected product remains untested |
| Original cap13/parallel3 forward forecast | **REQUEST_CHANGES** |
| Explicit cap18/parallel4/CI10/conserve10 forward draft | **Qualified ACCEPTED as minimum forecast**, pending separate authorization and fresh admission |

Inputs reviewed were `document.json` at migration revisions `84a64bc897b06c8d0db3d4c79ae7246d85b6f5d5`, `23811d7edf38346125fe5a9b03c089a728dc2507`, `3312b4e9aa987f88f0c680a6e9e5a6cb1e90d52f`, `a6be061c2d0b979ab4da108802ad6431ba2bd329`, `f9e96cce543cd69e85c7391772424675c864abf3`, and `547daf492430cb28f2370496a17eac46cf10474a`; original proposal `572b4aa…`; preauthorization journal `9ff981d…`; supplied old/current budgets, released lease, selected adapters, d1 binding and pool claim. Remote authenticity comes from the parent’s independently fetched immutable readbacks; I independently inspected their local contents and verified the relevant content digests.

**Critical findings: none established.**

**Important findings and disposition:**

1. **Original reviewer-admission deadlock.** `84a64bc.preflight_source.check`, lines29–31, rejects any owned lease; its `run()`/enforcement note requires that check at every future start. A writer awaiting QUALITY therefore prevents its required reviewer from starting. I reproduced this with a canonically valid synthetic managed-owned lease.  
   **Corrected prospectively:** authenticated admission code SHA256 `72653b43c12fd458866ffff9ad150152414167549aa27f1e1d5102cb51dc44cb` separates writer admission from read-only candidate review, authenticates the durable binding, requires Root SPEC and policy QUALITY acceptance, and recovers the real parent’s candidate/status/role. Product QUALITY may remain PENDING. The supported reviewer route is the budget reservation, one-shot pool claim, and `collaboration.spawn_agent`; generic managed-host read-only starts remain unsuitable because they acquire a lease.

2. **Original CAS primitive was insufficient by itself for policy activation.** `host_source.ledger_cas`, lines33–46, preserves neighbors and performs conditional readback, but does not itself enforce released ownership, unresolved-claim rejection, or a policy-only transition. The actual historical caller checked source/owner/guard and preserved events/wakes; it did **not** explicitly check unresolved claims. The supplied unchanged lease independently validates with **15 claims, 15 resolutions, zero unresolved**, so no actual unsafe temporary activation was established.  
   **Corrected prospectively:** the transition validator checks complete current-old equality, fresh source/revision, released boundary, unresolved claims, adapter-policy binding, and every nonpolicy ledger field. The ordered PENDING→ACTIVATING→ACTIVE journal/readback process remains necessary; these helpers are not a core override API or launch grant.

3. **Cap13/parallel3 cannot cover the remaining plan.** Ten starts are already charged. Four writers alone require total14; four bounded QUALITY reviewers require total18. With both old UNKNOWN seats retained, a writer plus its reviewer requires parallel4. Canonical budget simulation admitted four sequential pairs at cumulative12/14/16/18, each peaking at4 active, retaining UNKNOWN2 afterward. An additional retry was denied. Cap13/parallel3 denied the first accompanying reviewer.

4. **CI7 assumed an unavailable artifact route and did not address the conserve ceiling.** The observed workflow has one checkout/build, no four-SHA dispatch/matrix, and skips artifact uploads on PR events. Existing delivery therefore needs **2 historical +4 required PR validations +4 single-SHA artifact runs =10** under the reviewed route.  
   **Corrected prospectively:** `f9e96cce…` explicitly raises the same canonical task’s conserve ceiling1→10 and CI7→10, without resets or split task IDs. CI gate SHA256 `19221f9099ed12f4075a89308699e5b7ec26bf6e14d9f64c565f347239e2e8b9` restricts approved routes and exact SHA/attempt/operation bindings, counts UNKNOWN reservations, and rejects replay/over-cap requests. Its `prepare()` returns an **intent only**, with `external_submit_allowed=false`. Actual CAS/readback, canonical submission ownership/guard and supported external-route integration remain required.

**Minor/reporting findings:** original `bounded_exception_activation.actual_blocker`, `live_policy`, `current_coordination`, `charged_agents`, and `no_effects` contradicted its ACTIVE designation. Later observations correctly preserve these as historical and report current facts. Original retained-reviewer wording and cap13 stage-request bindings must be superseded before future admission. This reporting correction does not require unrelated suite reruns.

**Verification actually performed:**

- Recomputed canonical CDC package identity read-only: **352 files**, tree `9c45d98c3254e9658d452c505d8c97698e3fc9a7`; VERSION/manifest2.12.1.
- Verified all17 embedded original-file hashes and five requirement hashes.
- Confirmed temporary adapter SHA256 `316ed907…`, semantic digest `baf6971f…`, strict validation and exact budget parity. Semantic delta is only revision plus parallel2→3.
- Confirmed all22 old events remain an exact prefix of23 current events; wakes/task preserved; only one d1 reservation added. Its canonical binding digest equals operation key `a233f5e8…`; pool attempt/token match.
- Reproduced all seven original preflight cases, plus ACTIVATING and valid unresolved-claim denial. The actual immutable PENDING input denies admission. ACTIVE cases are synthetic.
- Exercised corrected admission checks and wrapper fixtures: approved held-writer review allowed without launch authority; forged bindings, wrong identity/candidate/purpose/runtime, pending dispositions, unsupported transport, and a **canonically valid guard** denied.
- Exercised transition preservation and stale/owned/unresolved/mutation negatives.
- Verified explicit forward adapter SHA256 `993994b5…`, semantic `107c1bee…`, budget `82c91ce8…`, strict validation, full parity and all nonpolicy ledger preservation.
- Exercised CI scope negatives and `prepare()` with a valid held-owner-shaped fixture and the real strict validator; it returned intent only. Wrong publisher identity was denied.
- Q5 analytical witness: old Fit→Size order yields bottom1070 in height1000; corrected Size→Fit yields bottom1000. **This is synthetic geometry, not WinForms execution.**
- Canonical cycle evaluator with the supplied Root strategy ref `git:refs/heads/cdc/strategy-gpc-Q5-cycle3-20261008@57945c00c856cc7dd2856b30333bcfd8411b2eec` returns VALIDATE, preserving spent2/max2 and all effect-authority flags false. The earlier null-reference record correctly returned REPLAN_REQUIRED.

Two test-harness issues—an expected denial substring and a PID-namespace descriptor path—were corrected; affected checks then exited0. Neither was a product/control failure. No unchanged full suite, SDK compile, native Windows check, CI, provider start, product write, or Git mutation was performed.

ID='sha256:e9c5798b2e5857d11563b10845ae993ed5b0e7b040ffd6611bdbd1a36aad08d3'
SOURCE='7aaefdebca68eed64c8e92d7dfff7384f0a3c800';REF='refs/heads/design/0.17.0-security-posture';COORD='refs/heads/cdc/coordination'
def now():return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace('+00:00','Z')

def git(*args,data=None,check=True,repo=None):
 r=subprocess.run(['git','-C',repo or REPO,*args],input=data,capture_output=True,env=git_object_environment(GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0',GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='G PC Health artifact host',GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='cdc@example.invalid',GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='G PC Health artifact host',GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='cdc@example.invalid'),timeout=30)
 if check and r.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Git failed '+args[0]+' '+r.stderr.decode())
 return r

def head(ref):

 config,end=isolated_remote_args(REPO,'origin',ID)
 rows=git(*config,'ls-remote','--refs',end,ref).stdout.splitlines()
 return None if not rows else rows[0].split(b'\t')[0].decode()
def read():
 rev=head(COORD);config,end=isolated_remote_args(REPO,'origin',ID)
 git(*config,'fetch','--no-tags','--no-write-fetch-head','--refmap=',end,COORD)
 l=json.loads(git('show',rev+':budget.json').stdout);lease=json.loads(git('show',rev+':lease.json').stdout)
 budget.validate_ledger(l);lv.validate(lease);assert head(COORD)==rev

def ledger_cas(rev,old,new,label):
 budget.validate_ledger(new);assert new['events'][:len(old['events'])]==old['events'];assert new['task_id']==old['task_id']
 assert head(COORD)==rev and head(REF)==SOURCE
 rows=[r for r in git('ls-tree','--full-tree','-z',rev).stdout.split(b'\0') if r]
 neighbors=[r for r in rows if r.split(b'\t',1)[1]!=b'budget.json'];mode=next(r.split()[0] for r in rows if r.split(b'\t',1)[1]==b'budget.json')
 blob=git('hash-object','-w','--stdin',data=(json.dumps(new,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode()).stdout.strip()
 tree=git('mktree','-z',data=b'\0'.join(neighbors+[mode+b' blob '+blob+b'\tbudget.json'])+b'\0').stdout.strip()
 proposal=git('commit-tree',tree.decode(),'-p',rev,data=('Artifact budget CAS '+secrets.token_hex(16)+'\n').encode()).stdout.decode().strip()
 actual=[r for r in git('ls-tree','--full-tree','-z',proposal).stdout.split(b'\0') if r and r.split(b'\t',1)[1]!=b'budget.json'];assert actual==neighbors
 assert json.loads(git('show',proposal+':budget.json').stdout)==new
 save(label+'-intent.json',dict(parent=rev,proposal=proposal,ledger=new))
 config,end=isolated_remote_args(REPO,'origin',ID)
 result=git(*config,'-c','push.followTags=false','push','--porcelain',end,proposal+':'+COORD,check=False)
 current,l,lease=read();assert current==proposal and l==new,'unknown/conflict: preserve intent, no replay'

 return current
